scripts.//dev:e2e: The stack as the Playwright suite needs it. That suite signs in far more often than a person does and would otherwise trip the 5-per-minute login throttle; see the guard in app.module.ts, which refuses this switch outright when NODE_ENV=production. Turborepo 2 runs tasks in strict env mode, so the variable also has to be listed in turbo.json's passThroughEnv to reach the API.
scripts.//setup: One command from a fresh clone to a running, seeded database.
scripts.setup: docker compose up -d && npm run db:wait && npm run db:generate && npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
scripts.//db:wait: Compose reports healthy before Postgres finishes initialising; this polls until a connection actually succeeds.
scripts.//test: Unit and integration tests. No database or network required.
scripts.//test:e2e: API tests against a REAL Postgres. Needs: docker compose up -d postgres-test redis
scripts.//test:e2e:browser: Playwright. Needs the full stack running (npm run dev:e2e) and seeded.
scripts.//test:load: k6 is a standalone binary, not an npm package. See tests/load/README.
scripts.test:all: npm run test && npm run test:e2e
scripts.//db-env: Prisma runs with its CWD in packages/database and only looks for .env there, so it never sees this repo's root .env. dotenv-cli loads it and passes it down; without this every db script fails with 'Environment variable not found: DATABASE_URL'.
scripts.//db:deploy: Applies existing migrations without prompting. Used by setup and CI.
scripts.db:reset: npm run db:deploy && npm run db:seed
